notes: All 31 tasks already implemented from prior iteration. Inner fix: tests/unit/inspect/runtime-benchmark-nfr002.test.ts was flaking under CPU contention because each of its 25 timed trials took a single process.hrtime.bigint() sample, so an occasional GC/scheduler pause on one sample (e.g. 17.3ms) could exceed the tight 2x-of-resolve/4ms-floor bound even though the code path itself is not slower. Changed each trial to take the min of 3 repeated samples (a standard latency-benchmark technique that filters one-off pauses while still reflecting true cost), and updated the persisted evidence description accordingly. Verified: full `npx jest` run is 100 suites / 957 tests passing, including 5 repeat runs of the fixed test and a run under artificial background CPU load; test-results/inspect-runtime-nfr002.json now records pass:true, violations:0. No task IDs or production source behavior changed; only the test's measurement methodology was hardened against timer noise.
